title: ORCHESTRA paper CPU userspace metrics CSV v3
maturity_class: userspace-validated telemetry with exploratory effective-action metrics
status: Linux remains the scheduler. This schema records bounded userspace observations and does not establish kernel dispatch, scheduler compliance, or scheduler-performance evidence.

compatibility.v2: The first 40 columns are byte-for-byte header-compatible with orchestra.paper_cpu.metrics/v2 and retain their v2 meanings.
compatibility.v3_append_only: Columns 41 through 66 are append-only v3 fields. A v3 reader must require the complete 66-column ordered header and the metrics_schema identifier on every row.
compatibility.analysis: Do not silently combine v2 and v3 rows in one statistical summary. Re-run and analyze each schema version under its own declared protocol.

q_definition: Q=(S1*S2*S3*S4)^(1/4); if any factor is zero, Q is exactly zero. S2 and S3 retain their historical v2 meanings.

zero_denominator_policy.S2_selected: 1 when eligible_workers is 0, matching historical S2.
zero_denominator_policy.S2_effective: 1 when eligible_workers is 0; 0 when eligible_workers is positive but no action attempt was observed. Rejected or stale frames contribute no effective successes.
zero_denominator_policy.action_specific_fractions: 1 when the corresponding attempt count is 0 (not applicable, not proof of success); the accompanying attempt count must always be inspected.
zero_denominator_policy.fallback_fraction: 0 when eligible_workers is 0 because no fallback occurrence was observed.

metric_identities.S2: S2 == S2_selected == selected directive matches / eligible_workers, with the stated zero-eligible rule.
metric_identities.S2_effective: effective_action_success_count / eligible_workers, with the stated zero-eligible and no-attempt rules.
metric_identities.migration_observed_success_fraction: migration_observed_success_count / migration_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.sleep_effectiveness_fraction: sleep_effective_success_count / sleep_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.yield_call_success_fraction: yield_call_success_count / yield_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.throttle_operation_success_fraction: throttle_operation_success_count / throttle_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.fallback_fraction: fallback_workers / eligible_workers when eligible_workers is positive.

per_worker_window_telemetry.aggregation: Each eligible worker publishes one coherent latest-action snapshot for the current frame under the existing per-worker synchronization contract. The CSV reports only bounded population aggregates, not PID-keyed records.

selected_action.claim_limitation: A selected action is a userspace policy request, not Linux dispatch intent.

fallback_reason.encoding: validated integral enum in worker state; aggregate CSV string in fallback_reason

per_worker_window_telemetry.claim_limitation: These are bounded userspace observations. They neither reveal nor prove CFS/EEVDF intent, actual dispatch order, CPU-capacity reduction, or another task's execution.

columns.name: S3_conditioned
columns.semantic: experimental eligible-worker weighted mean of within-state action coherence; empty groups contribute nothing and singleton groups score 1

columns.name: S2_selected
columns.semantic: policy/directive agreement: selected actions matching the valid directive divided by eligible workers
columns.claim_limitation: selected userspace requests are not kernel scheduler compliance

columns.name: S2_effective
columns.semantic: observable userspace action-attempt effectiveness: effective_action_success_count divided by eligible workers
columns.claim_limitation: not kernel dispatch compliance, not scheduler performance, and not proof of capacity reduction

columns.name: action_attempt_count
columns.semantic: eligible workers with a current-frame userspace action execution attempt
columns.claim_limitation: an attempt is not final scheduler execution

columns.name: effective_action_success_count
columns.semantic: attempted actions meeting their conservative observable action-specific effectiveness rule
columns.claim_limitation: not a count of kernel-compliant dispatches

columns.name: action_error_count
columns.semantic: attempted actions whose captured action_errno is nonzero
columns.claim_limitation: does not enumerate all possible Linux scheduler errors or all ineffective outcomes

columns.name: migration_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: does not prove a completed CPU migration

columns.name: migration_valid_requested_cpu_count
columns.semantic: migration attempts with a valid, eligible requested CPU
columns.claim_limitation: a valid request does not prove affinity or migration

columns.name: migration_affinity_success_count
columns.semantic: migration attempts whose affinity operation returned success
columns.claim_limitation: affinity syscall success alone is not observed migration

columns.name: migration_observed_success_count
columns.semantic: migration attempts whose bounded post-action CPU observation matched the requested CPU
columns.claim_limitation: a same-cycle observation does not prove durable placement or kernel intent

columns.name: migration_observed_success_fraction
columns.claim_limitation: not a Linux migration-success or topology-performance metric

columns.name: sleep_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: does not prove scheduler sleep state

columns.name: sleep_effective_success_count
columns.semantic: sleep attempts completing with monotonic elapsed time from requested minus no more than 1 ms through requested plus 250 ms
columns.claim_limitation: wall-clock elapsed sleep is not scheduling latency or dispatch evidence

columns.name: sleep_effectiveness_fraction
columns.claim_limitation: not proof that the kernel honored a particular wake-up or dispatch point

columns.name: requested_sleep_ns_total
columns.semantic: sum of bounded requested sleeps from current SLEEP-action snapshots
columns.claim_limitation: requested duration is a userspace operation parameter, not reserved CPU time

columns.name: observed_sleep_ns_total
columns.semantic: sum of bounded CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed sleeps from current SLEEP-action snapshots
columns.claim_limitation: does not disclose kernel run-queue latency or another task's execution

columns.name: yield_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: does not show that another process ran

columns.name: yield_call_success_count
columns.semantic: yield attempts for which sched_yield returned success without fallback or invalid-state error
columns.claim_limitation: successful return does not establish a context switch or scheduling benefit

columns.name: yield_call_success_fraction
columns.claim_limitation: not a fairness or latency metric

columns.name: throttle_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: does not establish a CPU cap

columns.name: throttle_operation_success_count
columns.semantic: throttle attempts that applied their bounded reduced-work/delay operation without fallback or error
columns.claim_limitation: throttle-operation effectiveness is not verified CPU-capacity reduction

columns.name: throttle_operation_success_fraction
columns.claim_limitation: not a capacity, utilization, or power-control metric

columns.name: fallback_fraction
columns.semantic: fallback_workers divided by eligible_workers, or 0 with zero eligible workers
columns.claim_limitation: bounded userspace fallback is not conventional Linux scheduler fallback

columns.name: fallback_reason
columns.semantic: population aggregate of current eligible worker fallback reasons; MULTIPLE means more than one reason was observed
columns.claim_limitation: not a complete signal-bus fault diagnosis
